svg.title: Splitting past records into training and test data
svg.desc: A bar representing 5,000 past member records. The first 4,000 are used to train the model. The last 1,000 are held back and only used at the end, to test the model on members it has never seen.
svg.text: 5,000 past members, each with a known outcome
The model studies these. It sees every detail and every outcome.
